comment: The nine footage ratios in the code are 1/16, 3/16, 1/8, 1/4, 3/8, 1/2, 5/8, 3/4 and 1 (src/H.cpp:58-62), which are the Hammond intervals relative to the 1 foot drawbar, and it is the 1 foot that the frequency input tunes. The phase modulation is weighted by the reciprocal set, 16 down to 1 (lines 64-68 and 103), which is why the lower drawbars move much further. Drawbar levels are square rooted before use (line 90), so the knob is a power taper rather than a linear one. The knob defaults are 100 divided by 16 times each footage multiplier, which puts the 16 foot at full and the 1 foot at 6.25 per cent (line 49). The panel prints the nine footages twice over, once for the knobs and once for their CV jacks, then FRQ, PM and OUT.
